summary: log-taker 0.0.9: shell execution via child_process requires human review
details: index.js imports child_process and invokes execSync with bash and zsh shells (line 315 bash, line 331 zsh). The pattern of spawning multiple shells from a package with a generic 'log-taker' name is concerning and warrants human review to determine intent — whether the shell calls collect log data as the name suggests, exfiltrate environment data, or perform other host-side actions. Without traced corroboration of the data flow into and out of those execSync calls, the specific behavior cannot be confirmed as malicious or benign from the keyword pattern alone.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
